draft.task: draft_expectation - first 5yr quality-adjusted minutes surplus vs expected pick value

construct_validity.define: Draft Quality = surplus minutes vs expected at slot (pick1 17483 baseline)
construct_validity.predictive: draft MAE 4450 beats naive 4501 by 51 when DeepMLP used; linear 4496 beats baseline by 4-5
construct_validity.threats: small-n 1598 heavy tail, 5-fold CV + Ridge L2 + dropout 0.35 guards

cap.task: cap_efficiency_vs_wins - wins per $M payroll, weighted wins, cap_pct

construct_validity.define: Cap Efficiency = wins per $1M payroll vs median 0.30 W/$M, weighted wins = W+2.5*POwins
construct_validity.convergent: cap_pct ↔ flex grade r 0.82, w_per_m ↔ Vegas delta r 0.31
construct_validity.discriminant: payroll not in draft X isolated, market size not used
construct_validity.predictive: wins MAE 8.9 multi-tower beats linear 10.08 in prior MTNN eval; linear cap model MAE ~6-8 wins

foresight.task: foresight_surplus - retained bargain deals where performance > salary, salary growth < cap growth, timing multiplier

construct_validity.define: Foresight Surplus = salary you didn't pay because locked early before $90M→$154M inflation — flat $26M 2018 = $55M now
construct_validity.discriminant: future cap% not used, timing mult capped 0.85-2.2
construct_validity.predictive: foresight MAE 0.75M best baseline 1.3M in prior eval
construct_validity.timing_notes: timing mult (1+capGrowth)/(1+salGrowth) 0.85-2.2 boosts older flat deals $90-110M now $140-154M, maturation_ratio 1+(cg-sg) .7-1.5 + era 4
